name: claude-usage-monitor
description: Status bar meters for Claude Code subscription usage: context window, 5-hour session limit and 7-day weekly limit.

commands.title: Claude Monitor: Connect to Claude Code
Claude Monitor: Disconnect from Claude Code

claudeMonitor.enabled.description: Show the Claude usage meters in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Context window of the current conversation

claudeMonitor.segments.markdownDescription: Which meters to show, in left-to-right order.

claudeMonitor.style.description: How each progress bar is drawn.

claudeMonitor.barLength.description: Number of cells in each progress bar.

claudeMonitor.showPercentage.description: Print the numeric percentage next to each bar.

claudeMonitor.showResetCountdown.description: Show time remaining until the 5-hour and 7-day windows reset.

enumDescriptions: Tokens used out of the context window, and percentage, e.g. 151k/200k 75%
claudeMonitor.contextDisplay.description: What the context window meter prints next to its bar.

claudeMonitor.warningThreshold.description: Percentage at or above which a limit meter turns to the warning colour.

claudeMonitor.criticalThreshold.description: Percentage at or above which a limit meter turns to the critical colour.

claudeMonitor.contextWarningThreshold.description: Context-window percentage at or above which the context meter turns to the warning colour.

claudeMonitor.contextCriticalThreshold.description: Context-window percentage at or above which the context meter turns to the critical colour.

claudeMonitor.highlightBackground.description: Also paint the status bar item background when a meter is critical. Loud, but hard to miss.

enumDescriptions: Notify when a limit first crosses the critical threshold
Notify when a limit first crosses the warning threshold
claudeMonitor.notifications.description: Pop a notification when usage crosses a threshold.

claudeMonitor.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to dock the meters on.

claudeMonitor.priority.description: Status bar priority. Higher values sit further to the left.

enumDescriptions: Only show the context window of Claude Code sessions running in this workspace
Show the context window of the most recently active session anywhere
claudeMonitor.contextSource.description: Which Claude Code session the context meter follows. Session and weekly limits are account-wide and always come from the most recent session.

claudeMonitor.staleAfterMinutes.description: Dim the meters when no Claude Code session has reported for this many minutes.

claudeMonitor.hideWhenNoData.description: Hide the meters entirely instead of dimming them when there is no recent data.

claudeMonitor.transcriptFallback.markdownDescription: When the bridge has not reported yet, estimate the context window by reading the session transcript in `~/.claude/projects`. Rate limits are not in the transcript and cannot be estimated this way.

claudeMonitor.contextWindowSize.markdownDescription: Context window size to measure against, in tokens, when the bridge is not connected. `0` works it out from the model: the `[1m]` marker wins, then the window Claude Code gives that family (Opus and Fable 1,000,000; Sonnet and Haiku 200,000), then a session already past 200,000 tokens, then 200,000. Set a number here to override all of that.

enumDescriptions: Use the status line payload if it ever carries limits, otherwise the usage endpoint.
Only use the status line payload, which no released Claude Code version fills in.
Do not show the 5-hour and 7-day meters.
claudeMonitor.rateLimits.source.markdownDescription: Where the 5-hour and 7-day meters get their numbers. The usage endpoint is `https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage`, called with the login Claude Code already stored on this machine — the same request Claude Code's own `/usage` view makes. Set to `off` to make no network requests.

claudeMonitor.rateLimits.refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read the 5-hour and 7-day limits from the usage endpoint.

claudeMonitor.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to re-read usage snapshots, in addition to filesystem watch events.

claudeMonitor.promptToConnect.description: Offer to connect to Claude Code on startup when the bridge is not installed.

colors.description: Colour of a usage meter below the warning threshold.
Colour of a usage meter at or above the warning threshold.
Colour of a usage meter at or above the critical threshold.
Colour of the context window meter below its warning threshold.
Colour of the meters when the data is stale.
